purpose: Paired genuine Bazel 9.3.0 vs native bazel-rs capture of native BUILD rule classes at loading. A: mirrors every step of tests/native_rules.rs on byte-identical copies of tests/fixtures/native_rules (plus extra wildcard builds of every gate package); B: one probe per ported load/analysis diagnostic; C: BUILD-time helper values written by a genrule heredoc; R: reference-only evidence (label_kind, --consistent_labels, --output=build) with the native rejection recorded.

native.binary: target/debug/bazel-rs (rebuilt from the worktree before capture)

environment: env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin LANG=C.UTF-8 LC_ALL=C.UTF-8 HOME/TMPDIR private, umask 022; scratch under /tmp/opencode removed=True

verdicts.EXACT: both succeed; query stdout / written bytes / set of built targets identical
verdicts.EXACT_MESSAGE: both fail; Bazel's primary message appears in native stderr (verbatim, or after per-line whitespace stripping where noted)
verdicts.EXPECTED_NATIVE_UNSUPPORTED: Bazel builds; native fails the build explicitly (not implemented / not analyzed by the native profile)
verdicts.MISMATCH: exit class differs, outputs differ, or both fail and Bazel message absent from native stderr (both recorded); mismatch_kind display_form_only = labels equal after @@platforms -> @platforms
